gameDescriptionHtml:
Take control of an assortment of superb mechs and engage in thrilling combat with other enthusiasts on the same battlefield! In addition to original mecha, well-known IPs such as “Mazinger Z” and “Dancouga – Super Beast Machine God” also ready for the mecha war!

With red-hot sparks, laser swords and rocket-propelled fists, a modern Mecha fighting game finally appears! Iron Saga, Game Duchy’s mech-themed mobile game, spins off into its Versus version: Iron Saga VS!

As a modern fighting game, it features robust rollback online play.

Now get in the robot and fight, Commander!

Game Features

  • NEW AND CLASSIC MECHA! – 12 powerful mechs are at your disposal to pilot, including some from classic anime series!
  • ARSENAL SYSTEM – Each of the playable mechs in Iron Saga VS can be outfitted with one of two unique Arsenals, altering their special move list and dramatically changing their gameplay. Will you use Mazinger Z’s missile arsenal “Bat A Thousand” or his photon power eye beam charged “Photon Power Commands”?
  • POWERFUL COMBOS AND SUPERMOVES – Fill your EN bar in combat to use your stronger Energy Moves, take advantage of Flash Counters to unleash powerful combos and unleash your Power Max Supermove to finish your opponent off! But in dire times, you also have access to your Awakening Supermove… will it be enough to turn the tides of the battle? Many control options also allow for basic combos to be easily accessible to players of all skill levels!
  • ADVENTURE ON WITH YOUR FAVORITE MECHA – Discover the lore behind your Mecha and its pilot in Arcade Mode, fulfill your missions’ objectives in the increasingly challenging Simulacrum Chronicle, learn the best techniques in the Pilot Academy or master your own techniques in the robust Training mode!
  • COMPETE WITH NEW AND OLD FRIENDS – Fight against an AI or friend offline in the VS mode, or meet online in a public regional or private lobby! All online play features smooth rollback netcode. Quickly meet new opponents in either casual or ranked matchmaking. Can you reach the rank of Grandmaster?
